underlines.text: his resemblance to the picture they had just been examining

reference.text: She stood several minutes before the picture, in earnest contemplation, and returned to it again before they quitted the gallery.

underlines.text: the gardener’s expression of surprise, on beholding his master

reference.text: When all of the house that was open to general inspection had been seen, they returned down stairs; and, taking leave of the housekeeper, were consigned over to the gardener, who met them at the hall door.
